name: InvenTree BoM Checker
description: Check stock, match parts with configurable AI, and prepare InvenTree builds with exact PCB-lot allocation inside KiCad.
description_full: Native KiCad 9/10 PCB stock checking with InvenTree, persistent Windows-encrypted tokens, automatic refresh after association and stock quantities in part search. Configurable OpenAI-compatible AI proposes exclusions and matches for review. Build orders reuse matching BOMs or create missing BOMs, with exact component and bare-PCB stock allocations. KiCad 11 is not supported by this SWIG package.
